sources.name: Pulse monitor simulator — obs (synthetic)
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

Pulse monitor simulator: J12 connects the controller to the sensor harness in a nonclinical patient-monitor simulator.
Operator note: an intermittent link interruption was reported during cleaning exposure.
This observation alone does not establish a cause or suitability for operational use.
No cleaning exposure test record accompanies this note.
Baseline revision and J12 pin mapping are not recorded.
Independent review is pending.
